llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and coherent for A/B test analysis: it asks for no credentials or installs nothing. Before using it, confirm where and how your CSVs will be processed (local agent memory, a remote API, or logs) if they contain PII or sensitive business data. Note the package metadata mismatch (skill.json vs registry version) and the unknown source/author—prefer installing skills from known/trusted publishers. If you plan to run real datasets, test with non-sensitive sample data first and verify the produced report and statistical calculations.
